text:
Situation: Sodium chloride 9 mg/mL, 50 mL (NDC 00264180031, B. Braun Medical Inc.) is low at Corvale East with 349 units and 9.2 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 117 units with 16.7 days. Other sites have adequate stock across multiple presentations.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show sodium chloride is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21, and the earlier shortage first posted 2018-06-21 is resolved. FDA inspection history for registered plants includes multiple VAI and OAI classifications and warning letters, but none occurred before the 2018-06-21 posting at a registered plant linked to our supply.

Our position: Supply is sufficient system-wide but unevenly distributed. No active FDA shortage exists. Alternative manufacturers are available and not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 units of 9 mg/mL, 50 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Buy from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — not on FDA's shortage list; plant last inspected NAI 2026-05-13 — needs buyer approval.
3. Buy from Medefil, Inc. — not on FDA's shortage list — needs buyer approval.
4. Buy from Becton Dickinson and Company — not on FDA's shortage list; label names no plant we could place — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No further actions at this time. System inventory supports the transfer and alternative sourcing without clinical changes.
